title: RadioSonde Track Status Mix
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radiosonde:track
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(track_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the RadioSonde track feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `track_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It scans the overall mood of your RadioSonde track feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
